lead: Deploy armies in secret and watch the round play out. Your enemy does the same. Adapt, repeat until one of you runs out of HP.

commanders.sub: Before round one, each player picks a {{commander}}. It sets your starting army, HP pool, a permanent speciality, and three Stronghold forge {{tactics}} (weak / mid / strong). Teammates share the union of their forge {{tactics}}.

runes.sub: Fused onto a pack for good, lifting every mech in it {{sep}} most packs hold {{packLimit}}, the ballista {{ballistaLimit}}. The four base runes are drafted from round cards or bought in the shop; the stronger ones are forged from them at the Stronghold, and never sold.
runes.shopTitle: Bought in the shop, or drafted from a round card

tactics.sub: These are the skills on your {{tactics}} strip {{sep}} rallies, spills, summons, and battle casts like the dragon’s fire breath. Battle spells are bought at your Stronghold, once each, and only the three your commander knows. Icons match what you see in-game.

roundCards.title: Round cards
roundCards.sub: From round two onward, draft one of several offered {{items}} cards drawn from the match pool. Battle spells are bought at the Stronghold, not drafted from cards.

matchSettings.title: Match settings
matchSettings.sub: The default rules for a match, pulled straight from the game's settings code so this can't drift from what actually ships. Everything here is tunable — it's open source.

contribute.title: Contribute
contribute.sub1: Melodan is developed by a single person, me. I am passionate about this game, but i can not make an AAA title and keep everything perfect, balanced and so on. The idea is to have an open game where anybody can contribute.
contribute.sub2: Let’s make this together. Balance, bugs, features, art ideas {{sep}} send a short note and I will read it. If you want to do more, welcome!
contribute.way4: Take care of balancing, invent new spells, cards, ideas.
contribute.way5: Welcome players, write guides, help with moderation if you want to take that on

about.title: About
about.lead: MELODAN is made by Alexander Thurn (Feuerware). He is located in Bonn, Germany.
about.inspired: This game is inspired by {{mechabellum}} the best game in the genre. MELODAN is an independent fantasy take; please support the original and buy Mechabelum. Thank you!
about.openSource: The game is {{github}} (GPL-3.0). Copyright stays with Alexander Thurn / Feuerware. Feel free to fork it privately, invent new units, and open pull requests. For something bigger, a non- or commercial spin-off, a full rebrand etc. feel free to write me: {{email}}.
